summary: An easy Old City coffee stop for tasting northern Thai beans with a producer-focused story. Choose Akha Ama Phrasingh near Wat Phra Singh for the simplest itinerary fit: a drink and a pause between temples, rather than a separate excursion. Akha Ama describes itself as an indigenous-rooted social enterprise built on sustainable farming and direct trade. The cafe visit is distinct from its out-of-town Living Factory; a normal coffee purchase does not include a farm visit, roasting demonstration or guided tasting.
whyGo: Taste Thai-grown coffee and compare roast or processing preferences with a barista.
Combine the Phrasingh branch with Wat Phra Singh and Old City wandering.
Buy beans as a practical souvenir; official listings include several roast levels and rotating origins.
bestFor: Independent travellers seeking an inexpensive rest stop
People interested in where their coffee comes from
skipIf: You want a full meal or structured cultural activity.
Your priority is a farm experience: the city cafe cannot substitute for one.
duration: Allow 30–60 minutes; longer if sampling more than one coffee.
cost: No admission charge identified. Allow roughly THB 100–200 for a drink and snack as a planning estimate, not a verified current branch menu. Wongnai lists examples around THB 60 for milk coffees and THB 90 for Manee Mana at different branches; confirm on arrival.
hours: Phrasingh: daily 08:00–17:30 according to the official website. Other branch schedules differ; Living Factory closes Wednesdays. Holiday exceptions are unconfirmed.
bestTime: Morning, as part of an Old City walk; allow time before the 17:30 closing.
gettingThere: Phrasingh is on Rachadamnoen Road near Wat Phra Singh, Old City. Official coordinates: 18.7883797, 98.9831619. Walk from nearby sights or use a taxi/ride-hail; check the branch name carefully.
booking: Ordinary cafe visit appears walk-in; no reservation requirement found. Any private tasting, workshop or factory experience requires separate confirmation.
accessibility: Step-free entrance, accessible toilet and ground-floor seating availability were not verified. Published descriptions mention upstairs seating; ask the branch before relying on access.
practicalTips: Ask which origin is available and describe whether you prefer bright/fruity or chocolate-like flavours.
Check non-coffee, decaf, plant-milk and allergy options directly; availability is unverified.
Select the Phrasingh map pin rather than assuming every Akha Ama branch is in walking distance.
decemberNotes: Useful flexible stop during December sightseeing; no December-specific event or special hours were verified. Recheck holiday opening shortly before visiting. Keep this as a nearby coffee break rather than committing a whole sightseeing block.
uncertainties: Exact December 2026 drink prices, holiday hours, accessibility and dietary options are unconfirmed.
Official hours for the main Coffee branch omit Monday and Tuesday; use the clearly listed Phrasingh schedule.
The sourced photo illustrates Akha Ama as published by Time Out; precise branch identification is not supplied in its caption.
